issue.title: Stop RN web drawing a line across a mouse that idles and resumes far away
issue.body:
## What

On RN web, with the mouse button held, the pointer idles, then the next sample arrives far away. RN connects the two points with a straight segment. Shipping web treats the far sample after the gap as a new contact and draws no connecting line.

## Why

Ledger rows B0009 and E0272. A dropped or coalesced pointer stream draws a long stray line across the child's picture. The historical ledger marked this as "possible on RN-web"; this run confirms it.

## Where

The RN web stroke input path, `experiments/native-architecture/src/drawing/PaperInputView.web.tsx` and the contact responder. Shipping's equivalent is the dropped-pointer recovery in `web/src/lib/drawing/engine.ts`, covered by `web/tests/engine-pointer-recovery.spec.ts`.

## Repro (rn-web, Chromium, desktop mouse)

1. At 00fcc5c78d1031873db1a214301c008daa4bd080, build and serve the RN web export. Open `/` at 1280x800.
2. On the paper, press the mouse at (20 %, 30 %) and move in 10 steps to (30 %, 35 %).
3. Hold still for 1.5 s.
4. Move once to (80 %, 70 %), then a few steps to (85 %, 72 %), and release.
5. Expected (shipping): the paper at (50 %, 50 %) is untouched. Actual (RN): a line crosses it.

Evidence: WEB-1 record, cell `engine-idle-gap-jump`, with captures `shots/engine-idle-gap-*.webp` (`docs/scratchpad/2026-10-18-device-parity/results/web-1-2026-10-19.md` on branch `claude/rn-web-parity-cloud`). The drawing path changed in #3006; re-run there before fixing.

## Done when

- A far sample after an idle gap with the button held starts a new segment, or is dropped, as shipping does, and no connecting line is drawn.
- WEB-1 cell `engine-idle-gap-jump` matches.

Refs #2978
issue.display_title: Stop RN web drawing a line across a mouse that idles and resumes far away

comments.body:
**Owner decision, 2026-10-20.**

The question was whether RN should match shipping, where a far sample after an idle gap starts a new stroke and draws no line. The owner answered:

> "whatever is better - doesn't have to match shipping.  If the shipping is a bug, don't hold ourselves to it on the re-implementation.  if shipping is better, obviously pick it."

Shipping is better here. A straight line across the picture from a resting mouse is the bug, so RN takes shipping's behavior: the far sample after the idle gap starts a new stroke, with Undo grouping as shipping has it, and no stray line.

Fixed by #3093, merged into `codex/native-migration` as 78225a2e299a6e8cf3d425ed20328eed1b985fa2.

On RN web a held mouse that rests and then reports a sample far away now starts a new stroke instead of drawing a line across the picture. RN calls shipping's own `pointerWasResumed` with shipping's `POINTER_RESUME_GAP_MS` and `POINTER_RESUME_JUMP_RATIO`, imported from `web/src/lib/drawing/strokeMath.ts`, so the thresholds can't drift. The resumed stroke stays in the same Undo group, as shipping groups it, and a resumed crayon stroke takes the next grain seed and closes its glaze group. The rule sits on the shared contact path; real finger and pen input on native can't meet both thresholds, so native behaviour is unchanged for live input.

**Rerun.** WEB-1 `engine-idle-gap-jump` on rn-web-chromium: before, `connectingLine: true`; after, `connectingLine: false` with undoDepth 1, web-prod's recorded values. Ledger rows B0009 and E0272 get their rerun recorded in the campaign's batch ledger PR.

The PR was gated against ebfc7dd5; the orchestrator covered the move to 6f1e85e8 with a local integration trial (check, lint, the RSD tier, test:browserless, native:web:build: first paint 45,628/47,052, core controls 822,240/827,535).
